evals.prompt: Run a Chrome DevTools MCP performance and network waterfall audit against localhost:3000 without polluting my personal Chrome profile or sending telemetry.
evals.expected_outcome: Uses --isolated --headless --no-usage-statistics --no-performance-crux flags and performance_start_trace / list_network_requests tools.
assertions: Avoids attaching to personal Chrome cookies without consent

evals.prompt: How do I invoke Chrome DevTools tools directly from shell without loading 25 MCP schemas into my prompt?
evals.expected_outcome: Explains standalone chrome-devtools CLI (start, status) or --slim MCP flag.
assertions: Mentions standalone chrome-devtools CLI or --slim flag

evals.prompt: Write and run a multi-browser CI Playwright test suite in tests/e2e/.
evals.expected_outcome: Routes Playwright test authoring and CI runs to playwright-cli or browser-harness.
assertions: Routes Playwright test suite authoring to playwright-cli or browser-harness
